title: Generative AI and Its Impact on Personalized Intelligent Tutoring Systems
extended_summary:
This paper examines how generative AI, especially large language models such as GPT-4, can be integrated into intelligent tutoring systems (ITS) to enable more personalized and adaptive learning. The central problem addressed is how generative AI can improve the flexibility, responsiveness, and engagement of ITS beyond traditional rule-based or static content approaches.

The paper discusses several AI-supported tutoring functions, including automated question generation, personalized feedback, and interactive dialogue systems. These capabilities are presented as ways to tailor learning materials, hints, and explanations to individual learner needs in real time. The paper also emphasizes key implementation challenges, such as maintaining pedagogical accuracy, mitigating bias, and sustaining learner engagement.

The article is conceptual rather than empirical: it synthesizes prior literature and examples of emerging applications across educational contexts, including school-level questioning, mathematics support, and language learning. Its main conclusion is that generative AI has strong potential to transform ITS into more adaptive, equitable, and engaging tools, but realizing that potential will require careful validation, bias mitigation, and ethical governance.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a narrative/report-style conceptual paper, not an empirical study. It does not report a systematic method, sample, or causal/comparative evaluation of learner outcomes.
impact_tier_rationale: No measurable educational impact is reported. The paper argues for potential benefits of generative AI in ITS, but provides no effect sizes or outcome evidence.

interventions.use_case: Conceptual review of integrating generative AI/LLMs such as GPT-4 into intelligent tutoring systems for personalized question generation, real-time feedback, and interactive dialogue tutoring.
Personalized tutoring systems that adapt instructional content, hints, and dialogue to individual learner needs using AI-driven generation rather than fixed rule-based materials.
